title: Route multiple PDFs into merge workspace
description: This verifies that dropping multiple PDF files into the hub routes the user into the merge workspace with the files loaded for merging.

steps.description: Navigate to #view-start
Drop multiple PDF files into the central hub
Verify the merge workspace is displayed
Verify the dropped files are loaded for merging

title: Route image files to scanning or image conversion
description: This verifies that dropping image files into the hub routes the user to a scan or images-to-PDF workspace with the images loaded.

steps.description: Navigate to #view-start
Drop image files into the central hub
Verify image intake routing options are displayed
Verify a scan or images-to-PDF workspace is displayed with the images loaded

title: Route dropped PDFs to the merge workspace
description: This verifies that dropping multiple PDF files on the central hub routes the user to the merge workspace and prepares the files for combining.

steps.description: Navigate to the central hub
Drop multiple PDF files into the intake area
Verify the merge workspace is displayed
Verify the dropped files are listed for merging

title: Route a single PDF to suggested tools
description: This verifies that dropping one PDF into the hub shows appropriate tool suggestions and lets the user open a selected PDF workspace.

steps.description: Navigate to #view-start
Drop a single PDF file into the central hub
Verify tool suggestions for PDF actions are displayed
Verify a PDF workspace can be opened from the hub

title: Reject unsupported files in the hub
description: This verifies that dropping an unsupported file type into the hub shows a validation error and keeps the user on the start screen.

steps.description: Navigate to #view-start
Drop an unsupported file into the central hub
Verify a validation error is displayed
Verify the start screen remains visible

title: Route dropped images to the scan workflow
description: This verifies that dropping image files on the central hub routes the user to the scanning workflow instead of a PDF-only workspace.

steps.description: Navigate to the central hub
Drop an image file into the intake area
Verify the document scanner workspace is displayed
Verify the image input is ready for processing

title: Handle unsupported file types in the hub
description: This verifies that unsupported files dropped into the central hub are rejected with a validation error and no workspace is opened.

steps.description: Navigate to the central hub
Drop an unsupported file into the intake area
Verify a file validation error is visible
Verify no document workspace is opened

title: Merge PDFs offline and export the combined document
description: This verifies that multiple PDFs can be reordered, merged, and exported as one document without leaving the local workspace.

steps.description: Navigate to the central hub
Drop multiple PDF files into the intake area
Reorder the files in the merge workspace
Start the merge
Verify the merged PDF preview is displayed
Verify an export option for the combined document is available

title: Convert multiple images into a formatted PDF
description: This verifies that selected images can be arranged in the images-to-PDF workspace and exported as a combined PDF with chosen page settings.

steps.description: Navigate to #view-images
Add multiple supported images to the workspace
Select A4 page size and portrait orientation
Set page margins
Generate the PDF
Verify the combined PDF output is displayed
Verify the selected page layout settings are reflected in the output

title: Merge multiple PDFs into one document
description: This verifies that a user can load multiple PDFs into the merge workspace, reorder them, and produce a single merged PDF.

steps.description: Navigate to #view-merge
Add multiple PDF files to the merge workspace
Reorder the files in the desired sequence
Start the merge
Verify a merged PDF is generated
Verify the merged document is available for export

title: Process a scan into a searchable PDF
description: This verifies that the scanner can detect a document from an image, correct it, apply cleanup, and produce a searchable PDF output.

steps.description: Navigate to the central hub
Drop an image file into the intake area
Adjust the scan framing and perspective controls
Apply a cleanup filter
Start the scan export
Verify a searchable PDF output is displayed
Verify the scan result appears cleaned and ready to save

title: Apply OCR to a PDF and export a searchable result
description: Verifies that a user can run Arabic and English OCR on a PDF and obtain a searchable PDF output.

steps.description: Navigate to #view-ocr
Provide a PDF document to the OCR workspace
Select Arabic as an OCR language
Select English as an OCR language
Start OCR recognition
Verify a searchable PDF export is available

title: Scan an imported image into a clean PDF
description: This verifies that importing an image into the scanner detects page boundaries, allows correction, and exports a cleaned scanned PDF.

steps.description: Navigate to #view-scan
Import a document image into the scanner
Adjust the detected page corners if needed
Apply a scan filter
Export the scanned document as PDF
Verify the scanned PDF output is displayed
Verify the cleaned scanned pages are included in the output

title: Protect a PDF with encryption and permissions
description: This verifies that a user can encrypt a PDF with passwords and permissions and successfully export a protected file.

steps.description: Navigate to #view-protect
Upload an unprotected PDF
Enter a user password
Enter an owner password
Select the desired permissions
Run the protection action
Verify a protected PDF export is available
Verify the protected document is reflected in the workspace

title: Create a PDF from images
description: This verifies that image files can be combined into a PDF and exported as a document from the local workspace.

steps.description: Navigate to the central hub
Drop multiple image files into the intake area
Open the images to PDF workspace
Arrange the image order
Start the PDF creation
Verify the PDF output preview is displayed
Verify the document is ready for export

title: Organize PDF pages and save the updated document
description: This verifies that a PDF can be opened in the organizer, pages can be reordered, rotated, deleted, and then saved as an updated PDF.

steps.description: Navigate to #view-organize
Open a PDF in the organizer
Reorder two pages in the thumbnail grid
Rotate a selected page
Delete one page
Save the updated PDF
Verify the updated page arrangement is saved
Verify the modified PDF is available for export

title: Open a PDF in the editor and save an edit
description: This verifies that a user can enter the PDF editor with a PDF, make an allowed markup or annotation change, and save the edited document successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to #view-edit
Open a PDF using the editor's file input
Add a markup or annotation to the document
Save the edited PDF
Verify the edited document is saved successfully
Verify the PDF editor remains usable after saving

title: Scan a clipboard image and export a cleaned page
description: This verifies that pasting an image from the clipboard opens the scanner with detected edges, allows enhancement, and exports a cleaned single-page PDF.

steps.description: Navigate to #view-scan
Paste a clipboard image into the scanner
Apply a grayscale or high-contrast filter
Export the scanned page as PDF
Verify the scanned page preview is displayed
Verify a cleaned PDF output is displayed

title: Split a PDF into single-page files and export as ZIP

steps.description: Navigate to #view-split
Open a PDF in the split workspace
Choose to split every 1 page
Start the split
Export the split results as a ZIP archive

Verify a ZIP export is available

title: Split a PDF into selected output ranges
description: This verifies that a PDF can be split into separate documents using valid ranges and that the split outputs are created.

steps.description: Navigate to the central hub
Drop a PDF file into the intake area
Open the split PDF workspace
Define valid split ranges
Start the split operation
Verify split output documents are displayed
Verify the split results are available for export

title: Unlock a protected PDF with the correct password
description: This verifies that a user can remove restrictions from a password-protected PDF and export the unlocked result.

steps.description: Navigate to #view-protect
Upload a password-protected PDF
Enter the correct password
Run the unlock action
Verify an unlocked PDF export is available
Verify the document is available without restrictions

title: Apply OCR to an image and export recognized text
description: Verifies that a user can run OCR on an image input and obtain recognized text output.

steps.description: Navigate to #view-ocr
Provide an image document to the OCR workspace
Select Arabic as an OCR language
Select English as an OCR language
Start OCR recognition
Verify recognized text output is available

title: Open a supported PDF and begin editing without errors
description: This verifies that a user can load a normal PDF into the editor workspace and reach an editable state successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to #view-edit
Open a PDF using the editor's file input
Wait for the PDF to finish loading
Verify the PDF editor workspace is displayed
Verify the document is ready for editing

title: Reorder merged PDFs before combining
description: This verifies that the user can change the file order in the merge workspace and the merge completes using the updated order.

steps.description: Navigate to #view-merge
Add multiple PDF files to the merge workspace
Reorder the files in the merge list
Start the merge
Verify a merged PDF is generated
Verify the merged document reflects the selected file order

steps.description: Navigate to the central hub
Drop a PDF file into the intake area
Open the compress PDF workspace
Select the lowest DPI preset
Set a valid JPEG quality value
Start the compression
Verify the compressed PDF preview is displayed
Verify a size comparison is visible

title: Apply a signature and export the signed PDF
description: This verifies that a user can draw a signature, place it on the page, and export a flattened signed PDF.

steps.description: Navigate to #view-sign
Upload a PDF
Draw a signature on the signature canvas
Place the signature on the page
Apply the signing action
Verify a signed PDF export is available
Verify the signature is reflected in the document preview

title: Convert mixed images into a landscape PDF

Select Letter page size and landscape orientation
Choose the auto-fit layout option
Generate the PDF

Verify the images are fitted into the generated document

title: Split a PDF into custom page ranges

Start the split

Verify the split outputs are available

title: Protect a PDF and confirm the secured output

Drop a PDF file into the intake area
Open the protect PDF workspace
Set a protection password
Start the protection process
Verify the protected PDF output is displayed
Verify the secure export option is available

Open a PDF using the editor's file input
